name: Koko
source:
She is Shiori's daughter and the No. 1 cast member at her mother's night club.

She often stares, squeezes hands and smiles innocently towards the protagonist. Her appearance may say otherwise but she is a pure and sweet girl.

She is wary of the protagonist who is seen as an undesirable lover to her beautiful mother.

Her heart is pure, and she just wants to become a bride someday.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=719516]getchu[/url]]
